original_title: France, Spain eye respite from wildfires as other blazes break out in Europe

ai_analysis.location: Southwestern France, Spain, UK, Greece, Portugal, Turkey
ai_analysis.detailed_analysis: Wildfires in southwestern France and Spain are no longer advancing, but other blazes have broken out in the UK, Greece, Portugal, and Turkey, potentially disrupting transportation and logistics in the region.
ai_analysis.immediate_forecast_24h: Firefighters will continue to battle the blazes, and the situation may worsen if strong winds or hot temperatures persist.
ai_analysis.strategic_outlook: The long-term impact of the wildfires on the region's infrastructure and economy will depend on the extent of the damage and the effectiveness of the response efforts.
ai_analysis.operational_impact: Potential disruptions to air travel, road transportation, and logistics due to the wildfires, particularly if they spread to urban areas or critical infrastructure.
